provenance: macOS `sample` (10s @ 1ms) of a loop calling compute_interface_surface on a 50,000-point four-color cloud (fixed seeds), one process per pipeline, commit c71964c, 2026-08-18. Top-of-stack CPU samples, idle waits excluded. Point cloud in -> interface out only; no benchmark harness.
note: Filtration sorting runs on 3 threads, so its wall-clock share is smaller than its CPU share. 'Unattributed' is deduplicated/inlined template symbols the sampler could not name.
